review_policy: Exactly one source-support predicate per Decisions call. With nonempty proposals, assess all material nonnull declared fields as a set, including approximate time, injury cause, negation, modality and original attribution. Probability >=0.95 preserves prior source eligibility; low/unknown/refusal holds the complete set. It creates no per-claim or wording verdict and cannot repair omissions. For an empty set, ask full-post relevance and retain missed-claim grading; never treat vacuous support as a correct negative.

ordinary_billing_assumptions: The single-question Decisions request's aggregate billed input is bounded by one published Luna model context, without hidden multiple-context replication.
Published standard token pricing applies to this ordinary direct OpenAI API project; no separately contracted or per-request fees beyond the reserved uplift.
The maximum documented long-context and regional multipliers cover applicable processing premiums; no Fast tier, hosted tools, gateway or other paid service is requested.

Reported total input/output usage includes all billed token categories; conservative settlement prices every input token at the highest applicable input/cache-write rate and all output including non-visible tokens at output rate.
budget: Reserve only the next call atomically against cumulative settled charge ceilings plus outstanding/uncertain reservations, at fixed persistent experiment state.
